verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents account-based sign-in without API keys ("just sign in with your Google account") and mentions paid tier access. That is a direct sign-in mechanism, but the evidence does not show that an existing consumer subscription plan unlocks the agent. Community reports say a Gemini Pro subscription gives nothing extra for Gemini CLI, that additional usage requires a separate Gemini Code Assist Standard/Enterprise plan, and that Workspace accounts failed to log in. missing for 10: first-party docs showing which subscription plans map to CLI entitlements, evidence that consumer Gemini subscriptions carry over, reliable Workspace-account sign-in, a unified developer subscription comparable to Claude Max.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent
